purpose: Correlate consented input observations with real Excel native state deltas while preserving ambiguity and content privacy.

activities.label: observe real Excel scratch state deltas and keep them unassociated when no human input exists
attack false intent cross-application matching ambiguity and temporal window boundaries
record live observer boundary and next human-session requirement

queries.expression: can real Excel state changes be classified as typed deltas without persisting content
does the system keep native deltas unassociated when no input observation exists
does candidate association avoid intent claims and cross-application matches
is the real Excel delta correlation registered in the FARMAKSIA suite

assumptions: Excel DispatchEx scratch sessions contain no user workbook and are closed without saving.
Content-derived signatures remain in memory only and are not emitted.
Temporal proximity creates a candidate association but not a causal or intent claim.
The live mode is explicitly opt-in and attaches only to an already open Excel instance.
The active application class is allowlisted and window titles are never retained.
kill_tests: A candidate association cannot claim intent.
An input from Blender cannot match an Excel delta.
Multiple inputs in the temporal window produce ambiguity.
An input outside the temporal window remains unassociated.
Raw content and unsafe capture capabilities are not persisted or enabled.
unknowns: Whether live Excel associations remain useful during rapid real human interaction.
Whether snapshots distinguish navigation and editing without reading private content.
How to expose an equivalent live native snapshot inside Blender.
Whether UIA and native state timestamps have stable enough latency for a causal experiment.
